target.purpose: Survivorship-bias-resistant validation of the frozen confirmed + SMA200/20 + Donchian research family

prohibited_fallbacks: static list containing only securities active today

membership_source.notes: Must include additions/removals and historical identifier continuity. A current constituent list is not sufficient.

price_source.notes: Must retain historical OHLCV for securities that later delisted/merged. Yahoo coverage alone is not assumed complete.

source_quality_policy.research_grade: Licensed/authoritative source with inactive securities, stable identifiers, full target coverage and auditable corporate actions.
source_quality_policy.diagnostic_only: Community-reconstructed index membership or incomplete inactive-security price coverage may be used only as a sensitivity check and must never set ready=true.
source_quality_policy.promotion_rule: No PIT result may be called survivorship-free or used to promote production until both membership_source and price_source are VERIFIED.
